structured_output.what_is_happening: This is one of at least 10 "BEEPLE" tokens launched within about 15 minutes of each other. They appear to follow a recent post by the artist Beeple (GeckoTerminal links x.com/beeple/status/2103695634804945012, but the post itself returned 403 and I couldn't read it). This one is a Meteora pool created at 04:14 UTC. The creator seeded it, and 100% of the LP is unlocked. It rose about 150-177% in 15 minutes, with $475-530k volume on a $28k market cap. GeckoTerminal counts 1,975 unique buyers against only 88 unique sellers, and GMGN flags 69 bundler wallets holding 37% of top-trader share. It is not the leading BEEPLE: DMZts..., created 8 minutes earlier, is at $238k market cap with $816k h1 volume.

narrative.description: A Beeple (Mike Winkelmann) post set off a rush of copycat tickers. Beeple has a history of mentioning memecoins (the LAPTOP token burns in Sept 2026, 'memecoin armies assemble'). I could not see what the latest post actually says.
narrative.why_spreading: A famous crypto-art figure posted something token-related, so launch bots and snipers deployed many same-name coins at once.

token_connection.why_this_token: None found. There is no website or socials, no DexScreener profile, and nothing links this contract to Beeple. The only link is GeckoTerminal metadata pointing at Beeple's post.
token_connection.competing_tokens: DMZtsWeDaPRGU4ziXxcEMuPbXh1BmDm5iR9LirT8ZoHG was earlier and is about 8x bigger ($238k market cap, $816k h1 volume). 2sRFHWB9... is another Meteora clone of similar size ($20k market cap, $294k volume). At least 8 more clones exist.

authenticity.evidence: GMGN flags 69 bundler wallets and 37% bundler share among top traders. The 1,975 unique buyers vs 88 unique sellers in 15 minutes looks like bot or distribution buying. The creator has closed out, and the dev-seeded LP is fully unlocked. Several near-identical Meteora clones launched at the same time with similar volume patterns.
authenticity.uncertainty: I could not see X posts at all. Some real retail spillover from the main BEEPLE coin may be buying this clone.

structural_risks: 100% of LP unlocked on a dev-created Meteora pool, so the owner can pull liquidity at any time
Not canonical; a much larger same-name token is taking the attention
Creator closed out (creator_close), so no one has a stake in keeping it alive
Liquidity is larger than market cap: a seeded pool typical of clone farms

structured_output.counterargument: The Beeple narrative is live and real, and there are nearly 2,000 unique buyers. If the leading BEEPLE keeps running, spillover into cheaper clones can double a $28k coin quickly. Top-10 holders are only about 21%, and the creator holds nothing. The creator's previous token reached a $1.1M ATH.

Whether the buyer count is organic or bot-generated

source_coverage.notes: The Beeple X post returned 403. A search for the contract returned nothing. News found Beeple's September 2026 memecoin mentions (LAPTOP) but nothing about this token. Reddit, Telegram and Discord were skipped because of the time limit.

structured_output.thesis: This looks like a bundled, non-canonical Meteora clone riding a Beeple post, with fully unlocked LP. The main BEEPLE coin holds most of the attention. A short spillover pump is possible, but the most likely outcome is an LP pull or a fade.
